name: sgs/physics-canvas
title: SGS Physics Canvas
description: A container-equivalent section whose DECORATIVE children become throwable, physics-driven bodies (Spec 38 FR-38-27 / D447). Only non-interactive, non-textual content may be placed inside — nothing operable or must-read, because a thrown object has no discrete single-pointer alternative for WCAG 2.5.7. Physics are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; children still render, static, in their authored positions.

sgs._comment_overlayNotAdopted: The background is the media system's `background` slot (supports.sgs.mediaElements, Spec 49 section 7.8): the Background panel is the shared media panel, and SGS_Container_Wrapper (via SGS_Background_Media) prints the element and overlay. An SVG drawn over a photo or video is the block's own kept layer (bgSvg* attributes).

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: composite wrapper rule (.claude/specs/31-UNIVERSAL-CLONING-PIPELINE.md §13.6, D152): this block MUST mirror sgs/container's wrapper capabilities (padding, max-width, contentWidth, gap, background) rather than diverging — it is a section-KIND composite so it KEEPS SGS_Container_Wrapper rather than going block-private (D294). Background migrated off native color.background onto the flat `backgroundColour` attr (D635-pattern). `supports.color.text` was turned OFF WITHOUT a replacement flat attr — every allowed child (core/image, sgs/media, sgs/icon, sgs/decorative-image) is decorative/non-textual and sgs/icon always sets its own explicit `iconColour`, so inherited `color` never painted anything visible here; adding a `textColour` attr would be a control with no visible effect.

content-band.label: Content band (throw arena)
content-band._note: The __inner band IS the physics arena — its rendered box is what view.js reads as Draggable's bounds and the Physics2D floor/wall geometry.

background.label: Background
background._note: `.sgs-bg-media`, the element SGS_Container_Wrapper prints for every background (picture, tile layer, video or SVG). A motion target so a Ken Burns or parallax layer moves the background alone, never the block's content; it declares no style clusters because its look is governed by the Background panel.

background-video.label: Background video
background-video._note: The same `.sgs-bg-media` element when a device shows a video: an effect that suits video (not Ken Burns) reaches it through this part.

svg-bg.label: Background SVG
svg-bg._note: `.sgs-container__svg-bg`, the wrapper SGS_Container_Wrapper prints around a background or foreground SVG (bgSvg*). A motion target so an SVG loop or `draw` effect layer reaches the SVG alone; it declares no style clusters because its look is governed by the bgSvg* controls.

surfaceBlur.description: Backdrop blur: a single CSS length (for example 24px) that blurs whatever sits behind this block. Emitted by SGS_Container_Wrapper via includes/helpers-surface-ground.php; empty emits nothing.

surfaceSaturate.description: Backdrop saturation as a whole-number percentage (for example 150), paired with surfaceBlur. Unset emits nothing; 0 is a legal value.

physicsGravity.description: Downward acceleration applied to a thrown body, px/s².

physicsBounce.description: Restitution (0-1) applied when a body hits an arena edge.

physicsEdgeResistance.description: GSAP Draggable edgeResistance (0-1) — higher resists dragging a body past the arena bounds.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
